components.name: Twitch Cannon
components.blurb: Fires faster than it should and breaks sooner than it should. Fenn fix it between shots and call that a feature.
components.quirk: Cooldown 40% shorter (+35% damage a second over a Mk2 pulse), but it malfunctions 20% a minute: the Fenn mend it in no time.

components.name: Spark Lattice
components.blurb: Every hit throws sparks into the neighbours. A Fenn engineer calls it free damage, then checks the wiring.
components.quirk: Splinters hit 3 cells beside the impact (+30% damage a second over a Mk2 pulse turret), but the turret takes 0.1 hp a second while it runs: the Fenn mend it in no time.

components.name: Market Missile
components.blurb: Cheap enough to fire on credit. One in four is a dud, and it comes with a receipt.
components.quirk: Fires scrap for ammunition and flies fast and agile, but a quarter of the missiles are duds: its damage already counts them (4 x 0.75).
